_comment: Badge taxonomy + persona presets. Replaces the legacy 60-string flat array (BlinkerLegacy/MissionControl/src/features/admin/badges.ts) with a structured catalog. Drops LEGACY_ROLES (admin / fraud / funding / posting / support / send_funds_to_lienholder — all flagged TODO-remove in legacy badges.rb). Lowercase canonical (legacy mixed lowercase storage with uppercase frontend literals; that drift caused real bugs per legacy 18-user-profile-edit-and-permissions.md).
_principle: Badges are the granular permissions; personas are the bundles. A user has a persona (agent | manager | admin | super_admin | consumer) which seeds a set of badges; per-user overrides add or remove individual badges. The admin-console UserEdit drawer surfaces this as 'pick a persona, then optionally toggle 1-2 badges' rather than the legacy 60-checkbox dump. Effective permission resolution = union(persona.badges, user.added_badges) − user.removed_badges. See architecture/10-admin-console.md for the resolution algorithm.
_consumed_by: mission-control/src/lib/permissions.js (badge-gate resolver — Phase 2 replacement for the legacy <BadgeGate> component pattern)
All child portals: persona prop drives UI gating downstream of the embedder
_case_principle: All badge ids are lowercase snake_case. The legacy mix of lowercase storage with uppercase frontend literals (per legacy 18-user-profile-edit-and-permissions.md 'Note on case') is fixed here. Frontend display uses the `label` field; comparisons use `id`.

_categories.page: Unlocks visibility of a top-level surface (inbox, contacts, admin console, etc.)
_categories.action: Unlocks a specific action (impersonate, suspend, view credentials)
_categories.task: Routes a task type to this user (legacy TASK_BADGES — kept but slimmed to live task types)
_categories.product: Marks a user as product-team only (no agent surfaces)

view_admin_console.label: View admin console
view_admin_console.description: See the org admin console (org tree, users, integrations, configuration, audit).

view_super_console.label: View super-admin console
view_super_console.description: See cross-org views, canon drift, audit trail.

view_audit_log.label: View audit log
view_audit_log.description: See per-org audit log of admin actions.

send_consumer_links.label: Send consumer links
send_consumer_links.description: Generate + send capture links to consumers.

co_pilot.label: Co-pilot a session
co_pilot.description: Mirror the consumer's screen + advance forms in real time.

add_tags.label: Apply tags
add_tags.description: Tag a contact with an existing tag (search-only — does not mint new tags).

create_tags.label: Create tags
create_tags.description: Mint new tags. Restricted to manager+ to keep the GHL tag namespace from sprawling (per personas.json _tag_permission_principle).

suspend_user.label: Suspend user
suspend_user.description: Mark a user as fraudulent / suspended.

view_api_responses.label: View API responses
view_api_responses.description: See raw integration payloads inside the agent surface.

view_integration_credentials.label: View integration credentials
view_integration_credentials.description: Reveal masked secret fields in the Integrations drawer. Audit-logged on every reveal.

edit_integrations.label: Edit integrations
edit_integrations.description: Modify per-org integration credentials + enable/disable providers.

edit_org_config.label: Edit org config
edit_org_config.description: Modify org-level configuration (markup, discount caps, packages defaults, states).

manage_org_users.label: Manage org users
manage_org_users.description: Invite / edit / disable users in this org and its child orgs.

manage_sub_orgs.label: Manage sub-orgs
manage_sub_orgs.description: Create / edit / archive child organizations under a parent.

toggle_test_mode.label: Toggle test mode
toggle_test_mode.description: Flip the org-level test_mode broad-switch. Confirm-modal required.

edit_canon.label: Edit canon
edit_canon.description: Edit the platform-level canon files (status mappings, integration registry). Super-admin only.

view_system_health.label: View system health
view_system_health.description: Cross-org integration health + canon drift dashboard.

task_fraud_review.label: Task: fraud review
task_fraud_review.description: Routed fraud-review tasks (CarFax, OFAC, PlaidDataMismatch, UserDataMismatch).

task_doc_upload.label: Task: document upload
task_doc_upload.description: Upload + validate consumer documents (DL, insurance, residence, employment).

product_rep.label: Product rep
product_rep.description: Product-team-only access; no agent surfaces. Mirrors legacy product_rep + product_only? predicate.

presets._principle: Personas seed badge bundles. The admin-console UserEdit drawer renders 'apply preset' next to the badge picker so onboarding a new user is one click + override 0-2 badges. Mirrors legacy adminProfilePresetsConfig.js intent but with our cleaner persona-based grouping.

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: Daily-driver call-center agent. Works the opportunity inbox + co-pilots consumers.

agent_senior.label: Senior agent
agent_senior.description: Agent with extended privileges — impersonate, view API responses, create tags.

manager.label: Manager
manager.description: Team lead. Sees metrics + assignments; cannot edit org config.

admin.label: Org Admin
admin.description: Configures the org, manages users + integrations + sub-orgs, edits org config.

super_admin.label: Super Admin
super_admin.description: Blinker-internal. Cross-org visibility, canon edits, credential reveals, audit trail.

fraud_reviewer.label: Fraud reviewer
fraud_reviewer.description: Routed fraud + underwriting + doc-review tasks; no opportunity edit.

product_rep_only.label: Product rep (no UI)
product_rep_only.description: Product-team service account. No agent surfaces. Mirrors legacy product_only? predicate.

_dropped_from_legacy._reason: These legacy badges were either flagged TODO-remove in legacy code (LEGACY_ROLES), have no remaining usage in the rewrite (legacy listings/promotions/messaging surfaces are out of rewrite scope), or were renamed for clarity.

renamed.refis: view_inbox (refi opps surface in unified inbox)
renamed.view_docs: (implicit — every page badge unlocks document view at the corresponding surface)
